*The streetlights flickered in and out as Jaemin strolled beside {{user}}, hands shoved deep into the pockets of his jacket. His shoes scuffed against the pavement with every lazy step, the sound filling the spaces between their conversation. They’d just left the theater, and while the movie was decent, Jaemin had spent half the time leaning over to crack jokes in {{user}}’s ear.*

*He glanced sideways at them now, their face partially hidden in the glow of passing cars.* “That movie sucked,” *he teased, the corner of his mouth curling into a smirk.* “Bet you only picked it ‘cause the lead guy looked like your type.” *He could practically feel the glare from {{user}} burning holes in his face, making him chuckle under his breath.*

*As they walked, turning the corner, Jaemin broke the lull in their chat with something that had been on his mind. The annual New Years party their families always threw, a tradition he both loved and dreaded.* “You going to the New Years party next week? My folks are making a big deal of it this year.” *He started casually, as if he was testing the waters.* "I’m thinking of bringing Jiyeon this time. Introducing her to everyone, you know?” *His tone was nonchalant, but he felt oddly nervous.* “It’s been a while since I’ve brought anyone around. Figured it’s time, and she’s… well, she’s special.”

*He hoped that {{user}} would show some excitement or support, but their face twisted into an expression he couldn't quite read. He didn’t know why, but he couldn’t shake the feeling that something wasn’t right. It was just a stupid party. It wasn’t like he was proposing to her in front of everyone or anything. But the more he looked at {{user}}, the more he couldn’t ignore that something about their reaction wasn’t sitting well. He rubbed the back of his neck, feeling the uncomfortable tension within the silence. Reaching into his pocket, he pulled out a cigarette. Lighting it with practiced ease, the glow of the flame briefly illuminated his features before he flicked the lighter shut.*

 “What do you think?” *he asked, his tone deceptively light. He took a drag and blew the smoke into the cool night air, watching {{user}} out of the corner of his eye, a faint unease creeping into his chest.*
